title: 3-Hour Berlin Highlights Bike Tour
description: See a side of Berlin that’s usually reserved for locals on a half-day bike tour. Without having to worry about getting stuck in traffic or finding a parking space, you’ll pedal through the bike-friendly city at a relaxed pace and stop regularly to benefit from the insider knowledge of your guide.

reviews.usertext:
Easy location to rally too and Alicia, our guide, was very knowledgeable and informative regarding the history and city features. Alicia was very pleasant and very accommodating to us throughout our 6 hr tour. We felt safe and the tour mixed the just right amount of riding with historical stops along the route. As a history buff myself, Alicia provide amazing details to each stop that I had never known previously. It has inspired me to explore even more on some of the historical events she described. The bicycle was comfortable, easy to ride and safe. One of the best cycling tours to date for sure. The best way to see Berlin for the fist time. Must do again when we return next time. Thanks Alicia and Flat Tire team for making our time in Berlin a memorial one.
The Ware couple from The OC in Calif.

Since Germany is big on bike-riding and I do miss cycling a lot, being away from home so long; I decided to look up a bike tour.

I signed up for this company’s Highlights Tour, and together with 7-8 other people; had Rhys as our guide. He was easygoing, casual and gave me information I would otherwise not have read up about. Unfortunately, it was a bit of a downer that the weather towards the end of the tour was not in our favour.

Nevertheless, I was extremely satisfied with the tour and will not hesitate to recommend this company to anyone who is interested in seeing the city from another perspective.

Alicia was an amazing tour guide with excellent knowledge. She told lots of stories and made the tour really interesting, fun and interactive, not once did I feel bored. The tour took us around the most important parts to see in Berlin and was an excellent beginning to the trip. Really helped us to know where to visit during the remainder of our trip. The tour was spaced out very well and were in each area for the perfect amount of time. 100% recommend this tour even if you haven't ridden a bike in years!

Simon was our guide on a tour with 20 riders. I thought the group was too big, but Simon had no problem managing with riders from age 77 to young kids on the back of their parents bikes. Guide did a really good job explaining the essence of Berlin from its early years, thru the war and post war up to the present day.
This was my first city bike tour and will do again based on this experience.

This was absolutely superb. The 3hrs went so quickly because it was utterly absorbing, fun, funny and so interesting. Sam our guide was from England & doing an MA in history in Berlin so he was full of knowledge and passion. We learnt so much about Berlin that has given us a greater appreciation of the place and it’s history. It was an easy leisurely cycle. We were a family of 4 (parents & 2 daughters in early 20’s) & we all agreed it was an unmissable highlight of our 3 nights in this fantastic place. Highly recommended.

What a fabulous way to see Berlin. This tour was the highlight of our trip. Our guide Elicia had an in-depth knowledge of the city and put this across in an entertaining and interesting manner. We would fully recommend this company who were very professional, bikes were well maintained and easy to use. Great day, many thanks!

This was the best thing we did in Berlin. We saw and learned so much on our three hour cycle around the city with guide Artie whose knowledge of history and the city itself was excellent. We will so the six hour tour next time !

Faultless. Our guide for our tour Artie was incredibly knowledgeable about all things Berlin and his passion for the city and history really shone through. He was incredibly helpful and accommodating, especially towards a friend of mine who is on the spectrum and loved holding up the rear!
He strongly recommended that we go to a local club Kitkat that evening - which we did and had the most magical evening exploring!

There is no better tour guide in Berlin than Thor. He is so full of knowledge, he knows all the dates and his passion for Berlin really comes through. Touring the city on the bike makes it super fun, and a good way to cover the city in a short amount of time. Book on to Fat Tire Tours and request Thor!!!

Our guide, Peter, is a local who has also lived in the US, so his English is that of a native speaker. He is extremely well-versed in the history of the city, and especially of the sites where we stopped during the tour. Friendly, funny, and very professional, he was a delight as a guide and made this a really entertaining and interesting tour.

Our tour guide was great - thanks Thor.
The route was very comprehensive and varied.
We did this tour on our first day of a 1 week stay in Berlin, with our two teens, in order to highlight the main attractions, and give us an overview of the city before we hung out and visited places more comprehensively. The tour did just that.
Great fun, entertaining and extremely informative.
Thanks a million !
Dermot & family

Thor gave us our tour on May 12, 2022 and he was the man. Full of knowledge and a genuinely good dude. He had a coworker with him (Nate possibly?) that was also a super nice dude.

The tour covered a lot of ground in a relatively short amount of time, meaning it was a lot of bang for the buck. Bikes were good quality as well and got the whole group around with no issue. Thor took the time to answer questions and connect with the group on an individual and personal level. Definitely take the time to chat about the Holocaust Memorial, it led to a great discussion in our group. Highly reccomend this tour, or maybe even the longer one if you have more time.

Thanks for a great tour, Thor.

Fabulous experience with a wonderfully skilled storyteller, Rhys, as our guide. Rhys was extraordinary in sharing his knowledge of Berlin. He brought to life the deep, fascinating history of Berlin... An amazing way to learn about Berlin. Anyone passionate about history, or not, hearing the past brought to life, how the past shaped the Berlin of today will love this experience. In addition to Rhys, the tour is well organised, well-structured with quality bikes 😊

Excellent tour of the main sights of Berlin. Ronan was an entertaining and well informed guide. We learnt why hitler had a tiny moustache, as well as about the life and times of east and west Berliners. Would recommend to anyone wanting a quick whizz through the city’s history, from the Frederichs to present day Berlin.

Excellent introduction to Berlin. The tour was well paced and allowed you to see many of the important sites in a very time efficient way. The bikes were great and the guide was excellent. Route instructions were clear and he made sure to not leave people behind (thanks also to his lantern rouge). The guide was highly knowledgeable but did not go into excessive details.

Nate, our guide, was fantastic! He made safe stops along the tour route to explain the high level important facts about each spot in Berlin. The bikes were comfortable and easy to handle. Also, the tour took exactly 3 hours. Thanks Fat Tire Bikes!

Our tour guide (Rhys) was excellent; very knowledgable about the history, a natural storyteller, humorous and creative. He really added his own touch to the tour.
The bikes very comfortable and riding through the city was very pleasant.
The tour took in all of the main sights which we could have visited ourselves but the tour totally enhanced the experience.
Rhys also recommended a Vietnamese restaurant for lunch which was excellent.
Well done Rhys and Fat Tire bikes Berlin!

Fantastic tour of many of the city's main sights, with a friendly and knowledgeable guide. The ride is easy going, with frequent stops. We found the guide was very engaging and was able to express knowledge of the city in a way that made it feel like friend describing his love of a city rather than someone performing a job. It certainly added to the experience of seeing the sights and thoroughly recommended.

The best way to get to know Berlin’s highlights. Alicia made it really fun and special. We rode our bikes in a group of 18 while Alicia, our guide, knowledgeably shared stories and facts about each of the places we visited.

Alicia was a excellent guide with plenty of interesting and informative facts at hand which she delivered with ease and good humour. The tour was enjoyable and fun at all times with good interactions. Highly recommended.

I took this tour to quickly hit many areas, which we did. The bikes are so useful and widely used in Germany. But the tour was made great by the tour guide Alicia, who was full of fun and knowledge! If you want to save yourself a ton of walking and time so that you can do other stuff, this is the tour for you.

We booked this in anticipation of our first trip to Berlin and this tour did not disappoint. Our tour guide Anthony was knowledgeable, patient, and funny and he was hugely successful in showing up all the major sites in Berlin. I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin!

Anthony was a excellent guide and his history lessons appreciated. We covered alot of important sights during the tour with a flat, relatively easy ride, just taking care to work within traffic rules. Bike helmets were provided. Racks on the back held our jackets w bungee cords when we got a little warm.

Myself and my 17 year old nephew done the city highlights tour today with Nate. The tour took 3 hours and is a great way to see the city. Nate was very knowledgable and knew lots of interesting facts about Berlin and it’s history. My nephew loved this tour and I would highly recommend it to anyone with teenagers, they are learning so much but also having fun. A definite 5 stars from me and my nephew.

In a town rich with history, it’s best to tour with a professional guide. Ronan at Fat Tire Bike Tours seems to have a PhD in history. We were blown away by his knowledge and ability to explain sensitive and complicated information on the good and bad parts of Berlin’s history. He was a lot of fun, and the bike ride was a great way to cover a large area. We signed up for the three hour highlights tour, but due to a booking error with Trip Advisor, ended up being offered a six our tour. I am thankful we did the six hour tour! It was amazing and we got a detailed explanation of all of Berlin’s major sites, and many of the small ones. The ride itself is broken up by numerous stops for history, so it wasn’t a strenuous ride. Again, Ronan was a genius and a pleasure to be around.

We took part in the 3 hour tour on a bright and sunny Saturday morning guided by Nate. The bikes were very safe, well maintained and easy to ride. Nate took health and safety seriously and ensured we were safe on the roads taking time to explain the routes. His knowledge of Berlin and associated history was excellent and gave the group a very good understanding of sites and their relevance. All of the significant historical sites were visited and a good explanation given of each. Berlin roads are very safe and the bike lanes are excellent.
All in all a well informed tour which I would highly recommend.

Our tour guide, Reece, was terrific! He brought us to places that held history and significance. He really knew Berlin's history and was so engaging, funny, and thoughtful.The tour was a highlight of our short 4 day excursion in Berlin. Highly recommend!

It was a great experience. Our tour guide, whose name I forgot, is knowledgeable, funny, and exceptionally thoughtful of his bike riders group. He made sure we were all together and that all of us enjoyed the tour and learning.

Well organised from start to finish. Nate took us to see everything we wanted to and gave us an overview of the history, and cycling is so easy and safe. Great tour and then we hired our bikes from him to continue our adventures alone. Thanks Nate, would definitely recommend this!

Ricardo was awesome. Honestly it was the best thing we did in Berlin and we really enjoyed his stories and passion for the history of Berlin and its people. My 15 year old enjoyed as much as we did. Make this your first excursion!! 5 stars all the way.

What a fantastic way to get an insight into some of the history of Berlin especially since we were only there for a couple of days, Thor our guide was absolutely fantastic and very knowledgeable. He also gave us tips and hints for other things to do and see and helped us get our bearings for our short trip to Berlin.
Thank you from the tight Scots 😉

SUCH an amazing experience. HIGHLY exceeded expectations. I usually don’t like tours, but this experience changed my mind so I will likely be trying this out more often now. Right off the bat the tour guide Reece was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, entertaining, and he made learning fun and engaging. The bike ride was super fun too, I felt safe and it was nice doing something active together with others. Cannot recommend this enough!!!!!!! 12/10

3 hour bike tour with Thor on our 1st full day was perfect showed us so many sites & gave us so much info.
The bikes was really comfortable and well serviced.
Great start to our time in Berlin
Definitely recommend

This tour was great! It’s a great way to learn your way around the central part of the city and know the basics and cool stories behind Berlin. From WWII to the Cold War to other fun facts, Sam was the best guide! He was knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful in any questions people had. I recommend!

This was a wonderful way to see the city! Our tour guide, Jim was very informative and told us lots of interesting facts about the city. We always had enough time to explore the sites before we cycled to the next place. As we were only in Berlin for the weekend this tour allowed us to see more than we would have on foot. Definitely would recommend to a friend!

This was so much fun. Our tour guide Archie was fantastic - friendly, incredibly knowledgeable, and enthusiastic about the history he was sharing. My family learned so much about Berlin and saw all the key Cold War and WWII sites along the way. Highly recommend. Thank you, Archie!

Booked this on basis of previous reviews.
Brilliant guide, young British lad with such a wealth of knowledge delivered so well.
Only tip I'd say is on the booking confirmation email it would have helped us old techno useless if it had also in conjunction with address said the meeting point is directly under the tower. Helmets provided, bikes were really comfortable. Nothing but praise for whole experience

This was an excellent way to introduce ourselves to the city. A great overview for a family with teens, loved seeing and exploring the city on a bike. The bikes were of a very good quality. Felt we saw loads and could decide what we wanted to go back to. We had a wonderful tour guide and my teens became interested and engaged. Great morning we'll spent. Thanks

This was a great tour. We’ve been on Fat Tire tours now in London, Paris, and Berlin and it’s such a great way to keep my daughter happy, get some exercise, and learn the rich histories of different cities all at the same time. Berlin has such a unique story, I’d definitely recommend this tour!

Could not recommend this tour highly enough. Ronan our tour guide was an exceptional tour guide, funny, charismatic and Irish with an incredible knowledge of Berlins past and present.
My two boys aged 9 & 12 loved it as did my wife and I.
Very flat city to cycle around with loads of breaks to listen to Ronan's insights.
Jess in the office was just as freindly and gave us plenty of advice on restaurants bars area to visit..thanks a mil guys you made our trip to Berlin !! 10/10

Peter was amazing. He taught us things about Berlin and Nazis and Communism that we didn’t hear on any other tour. We’ll worth it. We skipped a planned walking tour which we passed on our way. We covered so many more sights and had more time for stories about each place.

This was a great way to see all of the key sites in Berlin. Our guide Anthony was informative and entertaining. An American from Seattle who has been in Berlin for awhile , he provided a very insightful perspective on each of the sites we visited. We were able to cover a lot more territory on the bikes than on a walking tour and as a 70+ person, it was very easy. Highly recommended

Really informative and fun way to experience some of the highlights of this wonderful city. Our guide was both witty and knowledgeable and the tour was just the right blend of cycling and stops to see the sights and appreciate the history. Highly recommended.

This was a brilliant way to discover the main highlights of Berlin in a relatively short space of time. Our guide Artie was brilliant, very knowlodgeable and picked the right sights.
I absolutely loved the tour and cannot recomended it highly enough

I had been recommended this company by friends back in UK prior to booking a tour for my 13-yo son and myself during our short trip to Berlin. The tour was great, I would have gladly done a longer one as well as time flew by. I had been to Berlin before but there were a few things I had not seen or heard before. For my son it was his first time in Berlin and it was a great overview of the main points of interest. Thank you, and hopefully we’ll be able to do more of your tours when we are in Berlin next time!

Husband and I did this tour. Weather wasn’t great so we weren’t sure we would enjoy it. We needn’t have worried. Our guide Felix was fantastic. He’s so knowledgeable on the history of Berlin and made the tour so interesting. We felt safe on the bikes at all times and the route is very easy. I would definitely do it again and recommend it highly to anyone visiting this great city!

Great guide who provided interesting insights. We also had a couple of ladies on the tour who told of their personal experiences of before the wall, during the wall, and the taking down of the wall. So much history that happened in my lifetime that I didn't know before this.

Nate welcomed us to the tour and we all picked out our bikes. At each stop, Nate have us a brief chat on the sights and allowed us time to explore each spot. He was very knowledgeable and ensured we were together and safe at all times. The cycle paths he used were safe and easy to navigate. Highly recommend this tour to give you a great overview of the city!

Thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Had already seen some of the city and the sights we covered but was brilliant getting the back story to some of these. Simon, our guide, definitely knew his stuff but made it interesting. He was witty and engaging.

The 3 hours passed in a flash and we were sad it was over. Highly recommend as a way of quickly seeing key points within the city and getting history behind them. Great value for money

Excellent tour! Our guide Nate was great - very knowledgeable with a good sense of humour too. Would recommend as a must do activity for anyone visiting Berlin for the first time. Bikes were very comfortable and I felt safe navigating the mad Berlin traffic system

I'm really sorry that I can't remember the name of our guide, he is British and tall with curly hair. He was professional( knew things besides the site we saw), and he was nice and funny. The bicycle is ok, and the tour was accurate by showing us the main buildings and sites in central Berlin.
A great value for money. I highly recommend this tour.

Myself and my boyfriend visited Berlin in February and were recommended this tour by friends who had visited previously. We were not disappointed! A highly informative and interesting tour made better by out great tour guide Nate! He really made the tour for us and we left with a much better understanding and appreciation for the history of Berlin and Germany.A must do if visiting Berlin!

We love Fat Tire Bike Tours! Having done one in Paris and Versailles, we leapt at the chance to go on a Berlin tour with Fat Tire. Once again we had a very knowledgeable guide in Peter, who was funny, kind and great with our 9 year old daughter. We learned so much about the history of this complicated and fascinating city. The bikes themselves were light and in good condition. My daughter and husband opted for a tandem, which is a fun option with kids. Fat Tire is definitely my bike tour of choice!

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and found the pace and information provided, to be exactly what we were looking for. Peter, our guide, was very approachable and communicated very well with our group. The route chosen was not too intimidating for those less familar with cycling around German cities and the stopping points provided a great balance between cycling and sight-seeing. Overall a great tour which we would thoroughly recommend.
Great bikes and tour guide (Nate). Berlin was easy to ride and the 3 hours went quickly. This is the second Fat tire tour I've been on and won't hesitate to do another in a different city.

Most enjoyable part of my trip to Berlin. Nate was a very friendly, knowledgeable and fun guide. Very enjoyable way to learn the history and city of Berlin and I actually remembered a lot of it. Dont worry your not on the bike for 3 hours you get loads of stops. I would definitely recommend and I would love to do it again.

This bike tour was my favorite thing I did in Berlin. I learned a lot of interesting information and got to see all the things I wanted to! Reese (don’t know how he spells it) was our guide and he made the tour so fun, interesting, and easy. We had a great time and would definitely recommend fat tires AND Reese a guide.

I typically do bike tours in new cities but this one was by far the best - the highlight of our trip to Berlin! We had Reiss for the Berlin Highlights Tour and he was incredible! Super funny and smart and made the experience that much better. We learned a lot on our tour that was helpful to know before we went to other places on our own during our trip. Highly recommend this tour and Reiss as a tour guide :)

Alicia was a superb guide on our tour. She really could not have been better. Interesting information given in an entertaining manner. We felt like we saw a lot and learned an enormous amount in 3 hours. Bravo!

Our guide Thor was excellent. He had to navigate road closures and did so very well. The tour had the right balance of riding, getting information and time for a quick look around at the sites. It is great preparation to spend more time at sites that are most interesting to you.

Great tour - good value. Why?
1/ Our tour guide ‘Reece’. Entertaining , very knowledgeable - hearing stuff you never see in guide books. Reece also helped us with tips on other stuff to see ( and not to see!) & recommendations to eat ( Con Viet - 5 mins from tour finish).
2/ Tour covered all main sites and great way to orientate yourself around Berlin. Bikes very comfortable. My wife was not a confident bike rider and reluctantly joined me, but she loved it. Very gentle riding with plenty of stops. Highly recommend

Had an amazing experience in my biketour today and saw a lot of historical building and beautiful places. Our tourguide was a great Icelandic viking called Thor. He seemed to know all about German history. Thank you for this tour, I strongly recommend it to everyone who is visiting Berlin.

Excellent tour! Our guide was very knowledgeable and informative, but also kept the tour light and fun. He offered some great local tips too. The biking isn't too strenuous either (unless you choose one of the longer tours).

Just a disengaged regurgitation of guidebook lines. I learnt more about Thor - the guide’s - life than I heard about Berlin history. Little to no context given. Answers to imagined rather than real questions. Expensive and annoying. Would not recommend.

We did the Berlin Highlights tour in February. Was a busy tour with 20 people on it but didn’t seem overcrowded. Was lead by Jim who is English but very knowledgeable about the city. Bikes good and well maintained. Saw a lot of the sites particularly in the east. Had done their London tour previously and this was just as good. Cycle route is easy and flat. Recommended.

Really fun tour with a knowledgeable guide that helped bring the sites and history to life. Berlin is perfect for exploring on bikes, so flat and cycle friendly lanes. We both really enjoyed the tour.

Really great way for a family with teens to see the city. Enjoyed seeing the sites and the bikes, so easy to cycle in the city. Simon was great, so much knowledge. Great way to start our holiday here.

We did the tour with Anthony today who was just brilliant. A great start to our holiday as we got a really good feel of Berlin after covering the key spots. The tour was at a good pace so was able to take all the history in. Really knowledgable tour guide with the cutest blue eyes! #foursisters

First bike tour I have done so wasn’t sure what to expect. Our tour Sam was brilliant!
Each stop of the tour Sam provided loads of in-depth information and made the tour so fun and interesting.
Having such an enthusiastic/outgoing tour guide really made this experience. Me and my girlfriend had a great time and would highly recommend!

What a fabulous tour. Alicia was our guide and she was very knowledgeable on the history of Berlin. It was very informative and gave us a lot of information. Great for all ages. Biking was easy and didn't bike for more than 5 minutes to each stop. We got a great overview of the sites of Berlin. Really enjoyed it

We did the 3 hr bike tour which would really good. Reece our guide who was lovely, funny yet knowledgable. The cycling was great fun and not strenuous at all. A fantastic way to see the city! Would definitely recommend and I'll be checking out what other countries you are in too!

Awesome tour. Worth every penny. Alicia is a friendly, exceptionally knowledgeable and thoroughly entertaining tour guide. Engages adults and children with equal ease. Kept my 12 year old son engaged throughout the tour. A natural teacher. Made the entire tour interesting and fun.

Excellent tour guide, Arte. Knew his history of Berlin. Was very friendly, knowledgeable and enthusiastic. Bikes were good and the tour was the right pace for us. Highly recommend booking. Very enjoyable

I did a Saturday morning tour with Alicia. The group was about ten of us. Alicia was super enthusiastic, knowledgeable and good fun.

The bikes are comfy, the route really picks the highlights and I had a great morning. Thoroughly recommend.

We did the 3 hour Berlin Highlights tour with Nate. I am not very confident on a bicycle in general but this was thoroughly enjoyable - it helped that we were in a group on proper cycle lanes (for most of the tour) and given clear instructions on what to expect. I highly recommend this!

We had a wonderful "Berlin highlights" tour, with Simon. I thought I knew quite a bit about Berlin, but learned a lot more. Rather than stopping in lots of places, and hearing about unimportant details, we were shown a bigger picture, conveying more insight in the present and past of Berlin. Very well done!
This was a great tour for the family to see Berlin and much of its history as well as enjoy a bike ride through a very bike friendly city. Everyone (parents & two children, 12 & 15) loved it!

Our Tour Guide was Awesome! Alicia has an immense grasp of the history of Berlin and did a great job taking us through that history durIng our three hour tour! There were several small groups that made up the total tour and Alicia did a good job keeping us together but appropriately distanced considering Covid restrictions.

Highly recommend this tour!!
Completed this tour today with Alicia and we had a fantastic and educational time. They accommodated us with a tandem bike for our 7 year old which we appreciated
Recommandable tour. Good price, well informed guide with humor. Thx Felix for a wonderfull tour. We learned a lot and had good fun.

I love taking bike tours of cities when traveling, and this one was excellent! Alicia kept us entertained the entire time and displayed a great knowledge of Berlin's history. Highly recommend checking this out as a great way to explore the city!

We had Nate as our our guide, his knowledge was great and made for a super enjoyable 3 hours, he fab at his job!! Definately going to try Fat Bike tours in other locations now! Bike super comfy and everything was made really easy, do it even if your nervous it's well worth the money.

Absolutely loved our tour! It was the highlight of our trip. Mathilde was our guide and she was fantastic! It was a very cold 2degrees but we hardly noticed the temperature as it was such an interesting and perfectly paced tour. Our teenage sons loved it too - praise indeed!!!
One of the best biketours we experienced. Felix is a great guide, and made the tour both informative and fun.

Fat Tire 3 hour tour was a great way to see Berlin! Jessie was our guide and was very informative and ensured we were all comfortable and safe cycling around busy parts of Berlin. Cycling this beautiful city was a great way to see the sites and learn about the history. Would definitely recommend this tour!

Had the luck to book this in advance and take the tour on Saturday 19th
Perfect way to see all the important sights and landmarks of bicycle friendly flat berlin
We were allocated Rhyse .....and very knowledgeable ,witt
y and well organised Englisman
Clarity and voice is well received and nothing is missed
Highly recommend, bikes modern and well maintained for all ages to enjoy
Not to be missed !

This tour was excellent and offered superb value for money. The tour lasted for nearly 3 1/2 hours at no extra cost. It was not rushed and taken at a very good pace. Rick "Moustache" was very entertaining and we loved his chalk illustration of the Iron Curtain and the Berlin Wall. His love of Berlin was obvious. Thanks very much. This was much better than a bus tour.

If we are ever back in Berlin we would certainly book ourselves on another Fat Tire Tour.

Recently went on a tour with guide, Kieran. The route was perfect, most attractions and an easy ride. Bikes were fairly new and very comfortable to ride.

Kieran has all the facts, including some quirky ones, which made the experience lots of fun.

Highly recommend!
He made the tour fun and exciting, always watched out for us. We had good weather and the roads are very flat and easy to bike on, bring water on a hot day.

We (3 adults) did this tour on 10 August and for me it was the highlight of our trip to Berlin.
We had Tom as our tour guide and he was excellent...his knowledge of events/history, his delivery and sensitivity of same was great and he was good fun. We were guided through the streets of Berlin with no problems. We did the 3-hour tour starting at 10:00 and it was approximately 13:15 when we got back to the Fat Tire Tour offices. Thoroughly recommend this tour.

We have enjoyed bike tours in six countries and in cities across the USA. This was among the best. Anzl, our guide, was a combination of competent, friendly, funny (when it was appropriate--not always the case given the history of Berlin) and knowledgeable. The three hour tour was very well planned and kept riders in parks and easy to navigate bike lanes, even when there was traffic to contend with. This ride is an excellent opportunity to learn the landscape and a bit of recent and ancient history. Anzl also took great pleasure in helping those on the tour plan other elements of their trips after the tour was over. We highly recommend Fat Tire.

Everything about the bike tour was amazing and our guide Josh was awesome. His knowledge of the history of Berlin was second to none and he was very engaging and personable.

By bike, is a great way to see the city and much more enjoyable than by the hop on hop off bus.

Highly recommend

To be honest I wasn't sure whether this would be a suitable option for my kids (aged 12 and 14) given it was across a major city - but it was perfect! German cycle lanes and respect for bikes meant that we always felt safe and I asked the children to just stay close to our guide.
A fabulous and easy 3 hour ride with regular stops and descriptions at major sightseeing venues gave us a great taster at the start of our 3 day visit and introduced us to areas to visit in more depth later on.
Rik was a great tour guide - lots of info and offered a fabulous short history of the Berlin wall and how East and West were divided. I learnt more in 10 minutes than I have by trawling through books and videos over many days.
Kids prefer this so much more over walking! 11 year old did great and my 8 year old (who knows how to bike), was much more comfortable on a tandem. So much great info!

My husband and I did this tour last weekend while on vacation in Berlin. Our overall experience with Fat Tire was awesome. We initially hit a snag and had to change our tour date last minute and the staff was able to help accommodate us, no questions asked. On the day of our bike tour we were guided by Merren who was AMAZING. She was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We learned a lot and loved biking around the city. We have done bike tours in several other cities and this is one of the best for sure! Thanks for being awesome Merren!
Nate was our tour guide, very warm and informative. Despite the fact it rained constantly Nate was able to work around this not letting it affect our experience. Full marks!
Funny, informative and you get to see the top spots of Berlin and get to hear nice antidotes from the time of the wall.
Superb guide and really interesting few hours. It’s a great way to see beautiful Berlin. Would highly recommend

Had an amazing bike tour led by Nate seeing some of the highlights of Berlin. I was a little nervous at the idea of cycling through the city due to traffic and cars but it was an ideal way to see a bunch of landmarks without the hassle and stress of navigating ourselves. I didn’t feel unsafe at all due to Nate’s great traffic tips and a precise idea of what was next on the tour. Most enjoyable were the historical summations and details about what we were seeing. A building is a building until it has the explanation and relevance and meaning and our tour was full of incredible meaning. Nate has the unique ability of summarizing complicated subject matter (war) and hundreds of years of history and making it interesting, relevant and memorable. I was most impacted by the Memorial to the Killed Jews-such a phenomenal piece of architecture and experimental art. Really, an amazing tour!

Nate made this such a brilliant introduction to Berlin
He was very knowledgeable and funny
A great way to see the city
Will definitely do other Fat Tire tours

Nate delivered an excellent tour, telling us a lot of interesting information about Berlin and it’s history.
10/10 would recommend 👍
We did the highlights bike tour and it truly was the highlight of our trip! We saw so much and learned a ton. Kieran is super knowledgeable!

We had the tour with Jessie and this was very fun and interactive. We did the 3 hour tour highlights of Berlin. Jessie was very enthusiastic and good experienced. English was good and understandable. One point of attention is that a coffee break on cold days is welcome.

Today we have done the highlight tour, what an excellent way to see and learn about this city. A very informative and enjoyable tour lead by Claudia. Claudia made this tour for us with her knowledge and simplified way to explain complex historical matters. I highly recommend this which is suitable for all fitness levels due to the lack of hills in berlin x

This is one of the best City Tours I have been on. Going by bike you can get off the main streets and ask questions about things as you pass unlike bus tours. Our teenagers were reluctant but both really enjoyed it including some of the “boring history stuff” as our guide Mathilde was funny and very knowledgeable. Got the tone just right.

This was a real highlight of our 5 day trip. There’s so much to see and so much history here, so getting to tour the main sites with a truly informative guide Ansell and enjoying a leisurely bike ride too, was just fantastic. We felt it was worth every penny and such great value for money. We also felt incredibly safe on the roads and cycle paths, Berlin is so geared up for bikes and scooters. If you visit Berlin you won’t be disappointed with this highlights tour.

This tour can save you a lot of time to visit the scattered places of interest in Berlin. Besides, accompanied by an informative tour guide, you can learn more than doing it by yourself. However, I do hope we had a smaller group.

This was the highlight of our trip to Berlin. Our guide, Ronan, was awesome! He is so knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin's history and has an abundance of stories, information, and recommendations. We had a short amount of time in Berlin, that at the end of the tour, he provided us a "must-do" list of attractions, museums, restaurants, and bars. Also, don't be intimidated by biking in a large, busy city! Berlin has great biking infrastructure and drivers here are very aware of bikers on the streets.

This was a thoroughly enjoyable 3 hours. Our tour guide was Alisha from Canada. Really intelligent guide who knew the subject matter inside out. Very passionate about her job. The bikes are well maintained and easy to ride but you do need to be able to ride a bike. There are some busy areas of Berlin to negotiate but the majority is on cycle lanes. An added bonus was a little light-hearted informal quiz as we went. I was lucky enough to win.i also got a free beer for volunteering to be the person at the back. Well worth doing.

Hello,

First, the Fat Tire Bike co. provides excellent customer service. Through a combination of jet lag and general confusion I had misplaced the address of the rendezvous point and the staff were very helpful in coordinating our arrival (it's right below the huge needle!)

Second, the quality of the bikes are great. They are perfect for any gender, size or cycling experience level w/3 gears and high handle bars, wide seat, etc.

The logistics of the tour were a nice balance of efficiency with strategically scheduled moments to stop and smell the roses. We saw the highlights of the entire city but also took some deeper topics into consideration as our tour guide was a history scholar from the local university.

Overall, the tour was a great introduction to Berlin and German history more broadly while providing a great day.

It's a no brainer. You get a feel and your bearings for a city you've never visited before, by following an expert on a bike! You get some exercise too :) Our guide Mathilde was excellent, just the right pace with safety important too, a great knowledge of the City and it's history with a sense of humour thrown in too. Would highly recommend for all ages.

We did the 3 hour Berlin highlights tour and it was great! Sam our guide was excellent - would highly recommend to do this on your first day in Berlin as it really gives you a great overview of the city!

My 13 & 16 YO sons and I only had 1 full day in Berlin and wanted to see all the highlights. This 3-hour bike tour did not disappoint. Mathilde was an excellent guide - knowledgeable and funny. Berlin is a very bike-friendly city and we had no problems. We got to see much more than on a walking tour, and the kids were much less bored. Definitely recommend for families with older children and all adults - though I think there were some 18+ tours I might have tried without the kids.

We had a great time with Carlos as our guide. He was fun and included everyone in his interesting tour which was really informative (he told us afterwards he us studying for a Masters in Global History which firs with his enormous knowledge). I would definitely recommend

Couldn’t recommend this tour enough. We did it at the start of our 5day stay in Berlin and was the perfect way get introduced to the city. Our guide Rhys was super knowledgeable and made the tour fun and relaxing. The bikes were easy to use and comfortable and the routes were not overly busy with cars etc, a great way to see the city. In fact we continued to use bikes to get around the city for the rest of the week.

I did the 3 hour highlights tour in Berlin with a FANTASTIC guide named Tom. The tour itself visited many of the main sights and took you on a journey through a decent amount (of the huge) events throughout the history of Berlin and Germany as a whole.
I was more inclined to do the city tour on a bike as the city is so big and would take hours and hours and hours of walking to cover it.
Highly recommend this and thank you Tom!
This 3 hour trip was an excellent spend of our time. Our guide Sam was so knowledgable and narrated in a very catching way. Couldn’t have asked for more! Saw lots of the main sites to see.

Ronin did a wonderful job of giving us an informative and funny introduction to Berlin. My wife and I had a blast. The biking was not that intense, and even on a 50 degree F day it was a very fun way to enjoy the sprawling city.
Our guide, Simon, was excellent and the tour was relaxing and very easy for my kids(9&11). The bikes were not in perfect condition but not bad.......
A great way to see the main sites of the city! Thor was an excellent guide - he was able to answer all of our questions and he was very funny!
Nate gave a great tour & had lots of information to share! I definitely learned a lot. Super fun way to see the city!
What a ride, Thor was a excellent guide and this is definitely a must for anyone traveling to Berlin. Beautiful city with a lot of the history and the fat tire bikes were a wonderful way to see it.
We really lucked out with Sam as our guide. He knew SO MUCH and was such a brilliant tour guide. Great company. Only regret is not booking the 6 hour tour! Brilliant and a must do in Berlin!
The tour was a great way of better understanding Berlin and its dramatic history. Tourguide Nate did a great job in speaking clearly, keeping the group safe as well as explaining the history: nice!
Nate, our tout leader was fantastic. The tour was informative, well paced and hit all the highlights of the city.
Couldn’t recommend this more! Our guide Reece was funny and gave us lots of interesting info and stories
This was a perfect way to see many of the iconic sights of Berlin as well as a few lesser known sights! I had Sam as my guide and he was very knowledgeable and personable. He made this a great tour.

We booked this tour on TripAdvisor / Viatour and our family really enjoyed it - even though we were really tired out at the end of the tour (being inexperienced cyclists)

The condition of the bikes were great, and had a small basket behind the saddle to put your water, bag etc. They also provided helmets if you needed it.

The tour guide was very informative and shared with us lots of information on the Cold War, Life in East Germany and the Berlin Wall. We had thought that the tour would cover World War II but it didn’t - perhaps it should be clearer during the time of booking what the tour will cover
A fantastic start to our first visit to Berlin. Michelle was good fun & we learnt a lot about the city. Would recommend

Very efficient way to see and hear the things you would never learn wandering around by yourself. Interesting stories, which our guide Rhys was able to bring to life with all the fun details. Can only recommend!
The tour was so much fun and our guide Ricard was fantastic. Highly recommend this. We learned so much about the history of Berlin
Amazing way to see the city and learn about so many spots. Highly recommend! If you have a chance to get Nate please do!!
Great tour. Simon our tour guide was both informative and entertaining. The 3 hours went by very quickly and we not only learned a lot we had a lovely time.
Rhys was amazing, knowledgeable and made the tour so much fun! A great experience and so glad we did this
Simon was an excellent tour guide. He was knowledgeable, personable, and easy to follow through the city in the bikes..
Berlin is a large and confusing city. We loved our bike tour because we saw highlights of Berlin that would have required hours of walking. Our guide was knowledgeable, with a great sense of humor.
Reece was hilarious and make the tour extremely enjoyable. This tour is worth every penny. I highly recommend to all visitors!
We loved it! Rhys was our guide and he was so knowledgeable. We saw and learned so much about Berlin. Would definitely recommend Fat Tire Tours
Artie was an excellent guide! Very knowledgeable with tons of info but has a great way of telling the story to make it interesting and fun.
Such a great way to see the city! Artie was very informative and interesting, I really learned a lot. It was also a very easy ride, not too strenuous.

The tour was really good fun and is a great way to see the city. Our guide Alicia was excellent, really friendly and very knowledgeable.
Would recommend

Thor was an excellent guide. Great tour, great experience. Really good fun
Reccomend
Great way to see the city
Fun, informative tour with Peter. Well organized, good start/end point. Covered all the sites I was hoping to see and I definitely learned lots!
Loved it. Perfect amount of time, sites, and context. The biking made it fun and it was easy to stay with the group. Dan was super knowledgable and fun!
Fantastic tour. Highly recommended. Dan was a great tour guide and knew plenty of the Berlin history. Easy ride with lots of interesting stops along the way.
Great 3 hours on this bike tour! Simon was great. Full of useful facts, very educational and fun. Really enjoyable and thoroughly recommend! Thank you !
Artie was one of the best tour guides we’ve ever had. His passion gave us a new found appreciation for the history of Germany.
Really good your. Simon the guide was excellent, funny and very knowledgeable about Berlin and was able to cram a lot in 3 hours. Highly recommend for a great morning of history and culture.

We certainly had a BLAST and we were incredibly thrilled about our day! Informative, interactive, very professional however casual and comfortable. Indeed we enjoyed our tour guide and Berlin so much! Worth the time and every penny! <3

Artie was an amazing tour guide with a lot of knowledge and information that he shared while giving us a wonderful and relaxing bike tour of Berlin. Artie was funny and knew the history extremely well, an excellent navigator and friendly to everyone!
Really enjoyed this tour with Nate. He was very friendly and very knowledgeable about Berlin’s history. Great way to start your stay in Berlin.
Ronan was such a knowledgeable, upbeat guide! He was explained everything so well and clarified when we had questions.
Dan was an excellent guide,explaining key points at each sight in an easy and interesting way. Comfortable and nice bikes - fat tires are actually a good things on cobblestones

Thor was great! He was clearly very knowledgeable about the sightseeing trip, quick to answer questions, and he did a great job at making sure no one got lost while biking around Berlin. The website isn't kidding, the staff speaks great English! Thor lived briefly in the US and the other staff member who worked the front desk was from Michigan.

Dan was an exellent guide 👍
He was pleasent and had a great knowledge of the city.
The bikes were fine
Alltogether a great tour
The tour was really interesting. Our guide Thor seemed to know what he was talking about and the stops all had new information.

Thanks Maxime for a great tour today - our new best friend!

Berlin is a superb and friendly city with a rich history mixed with tragedy. Maxime brought it to life with detail, humility, and excitement, sharing his detailed knowledge in a friendly and inclusive way, and making sure everyone had a super time.

Totally and utterly 100.000% recommend this tour. We had a chance to say hello to a few other of the guides when we met, and set off in groups of around 20. All the other tour guides seemed also lovely, BTW.

Walking tours are a great way to see the city. I had been somewhat dreading some parts of the tour, because of the difficult topics in Berlin’s history - but we felt Maxime really did a super job of explaining the context - the gravity and awfulness of what happened, as well as the resilient way people were able to rebuild without ever forgetting the past. He brought humour and humility, and humanity, to the tour, and brought Berlin to life for us, and for everyone.

To speak with Maxime is to appreciate how talented some young people are - and gives us confidence in the next generation - he speaks about 100 languages utterly fluently, (ok, so maybe exaggerating slightly), but what struck us was how friendly he was to each and every guest!!

Thank you again, and if you are looking for a trip - you won’t go far wrong with these guys!

Peter
Very friendly guide, who could really connect with the group. Pleasant way to now the city highlights, specially because you can cover a longer distance
Such a great tour I went with my son who is 14 yo. He said it was the best part of our trip to Berlin. Engaging information and friendly guide. Thank you Peter!
Dan very informative tour guide! We did the highlights your which gave us everything we needed. Cycling wasn’t too strenuous suitable for all!!!
Excellent experience! Alicia was a great tour guide. The sightseeing of the city of Berlin were covered. Highly recommended 🙌

Excellent tour, we were worried about 3 hrs of biking although we are in reasonable shape and bike often, the tour was perfectly paced for all levels of bike experience, our guide Anthony was knowledgeable and filled with fun authentic facts only a resident could provide and helped create understanding of the personality of the city. Would definitely recommend
We had a great time with Nate on the bike tour. He took us to some highlights in Berlin and did an interactive map activity explaining some of the history.

Excellent 3 hour tour with Ronan - great knowledge & good humour where appropriate.
Saw places we would have missed and learnt what is actually old & what is not!
Nate was a great tour guide. He’s so knowledgeable and kept a nice balance of humour and information. Really recommend this tour
Excellent tour that packed the key sights of Berlin into 3 hours. Anthony was a charming and knowledgeable host who brought the city to life for us - highly recommended.

This bike tour was amazing!! Our guide was Thor and he was very knowledgeable and patient. It was a little over 3 hours which I appreciated and appreciated Thor taking his time and not rushing through. I would 100% do this again and learned/saw so much.
Fantastic tour despite of the rain. We loved the guide Thor! Great storyteller and entetainer ❤️ we strongly recommend this tour.

Execelent! The guide was great explaining and guiding. Amazing the places we went. The time between the stops were well calculated and we felt always secure. The guide was able to answer all the questions and was very nice.
Best way to get to know Berlin! If you are lucky, Thor the Icelandic God of thunder will be your guide.
Our super guide Alicia told with so much passion about Berlin. The tour was so nice, we recommend here to everybody

Very nice biking trip with an enthousiastic guide Alicia.
Perfect way to discover the city and get a short overview of its history
Was an excellent introduction to the wonderful sights and history of Berlin. The guide was knowledgeable, courteous and ensured everyone's safety and comfort was ensured. Strongly recommended.
Great ‘first day’ activity. Got my bearings around the city, saw and learnt about the most famous sites, received tips on where to spend the evening, and Nate was a font of knowledge.

The guide., Nate, was very informative & engaging..
Learnt more in 3 hours about the history of Germany than I did all through my formal education.
Nate was an absolutely great tour guide. Very knowledgeable, very friendly, and very on top of the logistics. We covered a lot in 3 hours but didn't ever feel super rushed.

Cracking trip with Nate yesterday. We did a bike trip in London last year and it’s a great way of seeing a city. Nate was fun, had a brilliant visual to help explain the complex political history/ carving up of Berlin and Europe and the entire trip itself start to finish was well organised. The cycling is very easy being in a flat city. We saw and learned loads :) Nate also ensured we navigated roads safely with each section explained. We will do another one next time we are back in a few months time. Definitely worth doing.
Excellent tour! Incredibly interesting despite the severe freezing cold!! Nate was a brilliant tour guide, you felt safe and informed!!
A really good overall view of the city. Very enjoyable. Alesha was an excellent guide. A nice pace. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to get a fix on where things are.
Fantastic tour, Nate was a very knowledgable and engaging tour guide. I will definitely be recommending this tour to all my family and friends that want to come to Berlin.
Thanks a lot to Jef (our guide) for the amazing tour. Jef showed is a loafers of cool placets to enjoy. I recomend this tour for everyone.
We can highly recommend a bike ride with Fat Tire Tour. Our guide Jef, was an incredibly talented storyteller!

Terrific bike tour of Berlin, hitting the highlights as advertised! Felix did a superb job, giving a great chalk-on-sidewalk history of the Berlin Wall that I found helpful and even our 14 year old found interesting. In addition to Ted Ed-level quality history telling at each stop, he did a great job of guiding us safely through the city and dealing quickly with a bike malfunction.

We've been on a number of bike tours throughout the world, and Fat Tire has consistently been top notch--they do a great job of training and/or vetting their guides.
A perfect guide if you love biking and history. Ronan was very knowledgable and willing to accommodate all the questions.

We did the 3-hour Berlin highlights tour with our 13-year old son. Really good way to see some of the sights in central Berlin. Claudia was very entertaining and informative. Loved the analysis of the division of Germany and Berlin drawn in chalk on the pavement at Checkpoint Charlie. Easy cycling as well. Highlight recommended!
We had a really good experience touring Berlin by bicycle. The tour was very detailed, explained things in a clear way and showed us the main highlights.
We did this on our first morning in Berlin: it was the perfect way to start our trip. Ronan was a great guide.
We had the most incredible tour with Felix! He was so knowledgeable and made the tour for us! We saw everything we wanted and learned so much history we wouldn’t have known otherwise!

Claudia was a fantastic guide. Engaging, knowledgeable and friendly. Our teenage son came with us and he thought it was great too. We rented our bikes for the rest of the day too and rode to the East Side Gallery. Well worth it followed by a delicious kebab at Diner Dach on Simon-Dach Strasse 11, a trendy area for lunch recommended by Claudia nearby. Berlin is so flat and the bike lanes are so easy to follow.

Booked a tour for our teenage children and us around Berlin. The bikes were in good shape and very easy to ride. Guide was Matilde who was extremely helpful and friendly. The overall group was about 15 people. Really easy pace, very safe route for the group. Lots of information given at each stopping point and any questions answered helpfully. Really interesting information delivered with humour and obvious research by Matilde. Also got a fantastic lunch recommendation afterwards. The kids , 13, 19, 23 all enjoyed it ( a result!!). Would recommend Fat Tire Tours as an excellent way to see Berlin.

A great way to see the sights of Berlin. We booked the trip for the morning of our first day in Berlin to help us get our bearings and see most of the main sights. Our tour guide Carlos was very knowledgeable, friendly and made sure no one was left behind. Thank-you for a fantastic morning in Berlin!

I only had three days in Berlin and by taking this trip on the first morning, I was able to see most of the 'big' sights with a great guide who really knew his history. The riding was very easy, no hills at all, and mostly on cycle paths. Totally recommended.
Absolutely fantastic tour; well paced and informative. Felix the tour guide was knowledgable, friendly and made the tour really interesting! 10/10 would recommend

The Berlin tour was great! Carlos was our guide and was a great teacher and was extremely knowledgeable as he is in graduate school for history. Has a good mix of humor and loads of history to pair with the great sights - we would definitely recommend!

Alicia brought the city to life, explaining so many things that we would never have known. Loved the fact that it was on bikes as well and felt safe on Berlin roads with adults and teenagers. Really recommend it - we will do it again in another city!

Absolutely excellent tour of Berlin - it was the highlight of our trip. Jim was a fantastic tour guide, he really knows what he's talking about, was really helpful with recommendations and even threw in a few good dad jokes. Don't go to Berlin without doing a Fat Tire tour!

Great highlights tour of Berlin. The ride was easy and we got to see a lot of sights. Our guide Nate was fabulous! He provided an incredible amount of information about Berlin and its history. It provided a great overview of the city. I would highly recommend the tour on your first or second day to help you get acclimated to the city. Overall a great experience.

To start our visit we booked the 3 hour highlights cycle tour with Fat Tyre Tours. A great way to see the city, get your bearings and make brief stops at all the places of interest, so that you can choose which ones you’d like to return to for longer visits. The bikes were comfy, easy to ride, our tour guide was brilliant, friendly and very knowledgeable. I recommend the tour highly.

Worth the visit....if you want to see berlin at its best then do this if nothing else.
Staff friendly and a joyous tour to be on.
Great value. bikes soooo comfy.

Despite the sudden downpour right before our tour, we really enjoyed it and found the staff to be very helpful and accommodating. The tour guide new a lot of info about the history of Berlin and it was a great way to see the city.

The tour went over 3 hours and by the end it was a bit long, but I would still highly recommend if you are looking for a quick way to see the key highlights of the city.

We did the City Highlights tour and very enjoyable it was too. Our guide was Kieran, a young Irish chap with an extensive knowledge of Berlin - no question he couldn't answer. Got a great overview of the main sights (6.5 mile route), at a relaxed pace. We booked tour online before we travelled, subsequently bought a Berlin Welcome Card and got the 25% off when we checked in. Refund was already processed later that day. Very impressed throughout.
The tour was really good and our guide Carlos was amazing! He had Lots of knowledge about the city and made the tour very fun.

Did tour on 30 plus degrees day. Tour guide Ansel was ace, at all times exained road safety (had 13 yr old on tour and felt safe). More importantly he found us shade on stops. Just right length of tour and did pick up all highlights. Ansel was very personable and knowledgeable and we learned loads. Definately would recommend. Oh ... easy to find hire centre too.

Great tour guide (Matilde) who brought Berlin to life. All enjoyed from 12 to 55.

Why trip advisor insists on 100 characters, I have no idea, but presumably this gets me to the limit.

We booked this as we wanted to see as much as possible of the City but not be either walking or hoping on and off a bus. The cycling was really easy as the city is very level and bikes where well maintained. The guide Claudia was great, just the right balance of information but also asked us questions and to give our thoughts on things we saw which given the history of the city was important and quite refreshing. She also gave us information about museums we hadn’t heard of and recommendations of buildings to visit that we didn’t know about which gave us more to go and see after the tour. We covered all of the main sites and didn’t feel rushed or that it took to long.. All in all great value for money and definitely the best tour we’ve done

I had one day off in Berlin after a business trip and decided to take the 3 hours bike tour. To my surprise it was run by Fat Tire, the same company that runs a bike tour in Chicago that I took before and really liked. As expected, the tour was great with an excellent guide, Ansel, who told us great stories about the locations we visited and reminded me of all my History lessons from high school. I strongly recommend this bike tour to anyone doing a solo trip. It’s good though to be familiar with biking in cities with lots of people and cars around, or being able to pay attention and follow simple instructions. Otherwise you’ll be putting yourself and others in danger.

We joined this bike tour with our 10yr old on his own bike, and 7yr old and 5yr old on tagalongs. The tour was very interesting and the kids liked it too! Thanks to our guide Ansel for a safe, fun and informative ride.

My son said he wanted to ride bikes in Berlin and on most vacations. We saw so much in the few hours on the tour, just the right amount of time to enjoy the sights and help you figure out where you want to spend extra time. Our guide was knowledgeable and would so recommend.

This is a brilliant way to orientate yourself on the location of all the main sights in Berlin. The route takes in the highlights at a comfortable pace. Josh our guide was very knowledgeable and a very likeable chap who gave just the right amount of detail at each stopping point. He rode at the front of the group but was considerate in ensuring everyone stayed together through the traffic. I would suggest that less confident cyclists stay at the front of the group so they can be sure to get through the traffic lights with the guide as soon as they go green. Highly recommended.
What a great way to see Berlin. Easy riding so great for kids too. Tour guide was very knowledgeable, can highly recommend to all.
Excellent. Tour guide ( Nate) was brilliant. Informative, helpful kept the tour at a good pace and made the tour an enjoyable experience for everyone in the group.
Our tour guide Nate was brilliant. Was very knowledgeable in every site we visited and answered any questions we had. Had a very good mix of history and humour! Highly recommend

We did the City Highlights Tour with our two kids ages 11 and 12. Our tour guide, Nate, was very knowledgeable and funny. We got to see the major sites in Berlin in a nutshell which allowed us to see most of the city and pick out where we wanted to return to during our visit. Berlin is mostly flat so it made the bicycling pretty smooth and enjoyable. We all had a great time!

Very enjoyable, efficient tour of Berlin highlights. Great for your first morning in town to help you plan the rest of your visit. Felix is an excellent guide: charming, knowledgeable, with a wry sense of humor and he is clearly enamored by his adopted hometown.
The bikes are in excellent condition and provide a safe, easy ride, and they provide helmets. Berlin is completely flat so the ride is not challenging and suitable for any level of fitness.
We thoroughly enjoyed the experience and felt it well worth the cost.
Ideal to see principal monuments of the city and have a good refresh of the city history. I recommend!
Our guide was Sam, and he was fantastic. Very informative and fun tour. Bikes are good quality and easy to ride. highly recommend.

Did tour with 3 kids (16/13/11) - no problems. We all really enjoyed it. Berlin super flat and not huge distances between locations. Rhys was our guide, and was super friendly, and informative. Gave us time to stop off at Jewish memorial, and checkpoint charlie, and have a wander/get a drink or whatever. Gave us a tip for a good swimming pool too, which was great. The kids were initially very hesitant doing a bike tour, but afterwards said it was the highlight of the trip. Would recommend both for the historical aspect and to get your bearings of the city.
Bikes comfortable, and easy to ride, smaller bike was made available for our 11 year old.

Went on our city highlights tour yesterday with Merren. She was an amazing guide, super passionate, informative and kept the tour interesting. It was a great way to get our bearings around the city and plan out the areas we wanted to go back and visit for longer. Recommend doing this tour on your first day in Berlin. After doing the tour Merren stayed back to give us recommendations on places to go in Berlin and advice on the best way to get around. We visited some amazing restaurants from her recommendation that we may have not found otherwise. Thank you for a great introduction to this amazing city!

The tour and tour guide (Alicia) was phenomenal. Alicia was so knowledgeable on the history of Berlin, it’s buildings, The Wall, etc. I wish we were in town for another day so we could book another one of their tours. I highly recommend taking in the sites via Fat Tire Tours. It’s well worth the time. Better than the bus tours.

This was a great tour. Our tour guide was Merren who did a brilliant job. Super enthusiastic and very knowledgeable - certainly one of the best guides we’ve had. Bikes good condition and Berlin is a perfect city to cycle around.

We did the highlights tour on our first full day in Berlin. This was an interesting tour and a good way to get oriented in the city. However, the bikes are not very well maintained. I fell off the bike and cracked a rib on a smooth surface because the front tyre was completely bald and it slipped and spun the handlebars on a tiny ridge in the pavement. Limited our activities for the rest of the holiday, which was really annoying.

An excellent bike tour with Fat Tires bike Tours. Sam was our guide, he was very knowledgable, looked after the group well. Sam kept the tour interesting, enjoyable and fun. I would highly recommend the tour as it covers lots of the main attractions and with the distances involved in the city of Berlin, it’s a great way to get around. Sam was a great guide definitely 5 stars.

A very enjoyable interesting tour, made exceptional by our guide Sam ... He is very knowledgeable and puts it across with such enthusiasm and passion, it was captivating and so interesting.. he was happy to answer any questions and made sure we were well taken care of .. would highly recommend this tour with Sam
Di and Col

Travelling as a group of 2 couples, we all thoroughly enjoyed this bike tour! Matilde was an excellent, enthusiastic, interesting guide. It was fun, easy-going, interesting we saw all of the main sites we wanted to. The cycling was all flat and easy going. Fantastic! Highly recommend.

The guide Arnie was very helpful, enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Would recommend for any first timers coming into Berlin as it covers alot of the best sights while being really enjoyable and interesting.

Would highly re3this tour. Just the right length of time to visit all the major sights. Our guide Matild was very informative and interesting. We loved it so much we went back the next day and hired bikes to do our own tour. Thanks for a great tour.
A big recommendation for this tour. The guide Ronan was a treasure trove of information and knowledge about Berlin. All the main sights seen!

This was a great way to see some of the many highlights of central Berlin. Tom was an excellent leader, who gave us lots of interesting information - serious when it was appropriate, otherwise lots of entertaining details. Checkpoint Charlie was very touristy and rather tawdry but not to be missed. Other places were very moving. We never felt hurried and it was definitely a tour for all ages. Thoroughly recommended.
